verify.evidence: Program phase. 2026-11-14: the ADR-1287 increment is still in the tree, and the first creation-time coaching slice is in (lib/builder/vera-coach.test.ts, lib/ai/vera/block-coach.test.ts, app/(main)/pages/canvas/actions.test.ts, components/builder/inspector/vera-block-coach.test.tsx). Stays manual: the gate (one prompt to a valid, reviewable, single-undo page) has no page composer to probe, and ADR-1939 §4 (Vera coaches with questions only, never drafts as diffs) changes what that gate can mean for copy, which is an owner-session decomposition (ADR-1573).

append.detail:
2026-11-14 (first creation-time slice, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS; no migration). Built to ADR-1939 §4 (questions only, never copy, never drafts as diffs) and ADR-976 D-4 (speaks first only at creation). SHIPPED: lib/builder/vera-coach.ts (pure) mints one Anthropic tool per block from the block contract's own fields (coachTool over inspectorFields, the E5 field list), the reseedBlockCopy idea turned to coaching. Every leaf of its schema is a closed enum: field is one of that block's word fields (text and textarea only; urls, toggles, enums, images and lists are not asked about) and questionId is one of the reviewed catalog's ids (lib/ai/coaching-question-catalog.ts). There is no string field at all, so no draft, rewrite or injected instruction has a channel back; the test walks the schema and asserts it. parseBlockCoaching reads the reply against THIS block and rejects it whole on any unknown field, unreviewed id, extra key or count over 3; the wording shown is the catalog's, labelled with the field's label. veraMayCoachBlock is the creation-time rule: block-created only while every word field is empty, asked always, edit, idle and save never. fallbackBlockCoaching is the no-model answer. lib/ai/vera/block-coach.ts coachNewBlock is the model half: null and no spend when EDITOR_CANVAS is off (envFlag); one forced tool call (haiku, 300 tokens) through withVoice (lib/ai/voice.ts), under the existing seed-compose budget key (the key reseedBlockCopy already spends under; none coined), behind aiEnabled, featureOverBudget and aiRateLimited; AI off, over the cap, rate limited, a thrown call or a reply that does not parse all return the fixed fallback questions. Never throws. Per-Space retrieval is threaded in: the context can carry lib/ai/space-grounding.ts loadSpaceGrounding (public About and offerings) as untrusted data that only steers which question. app/(main)/pages/canvas/actions.ts askVeraAboutCanvasBlock: staff only (getJanitor), off without the switch, the block and its fields fixed on the server (the Banner contract on space-site), client values reduced to capped strings, the trigger re-checked server side. components/builder/inspector/vera-block-coach.tsx sits under the responsive inspector on /pages/canvas: it asks once by itself when the block mounts with its word fields empty, otherwise only on Ask Vera; it renders questions and has no input, so nothing it shows can reach a field. Tests mock every model call (no real call). REMAINS on this row, and why: (1) the coach is mounted only on the staff canvas's demo Banner, not on the selected block of a real document in the Space page builder or the website builder shell (those mount points are BLD/E5 work still open on PROG-E5); (2) reseedBlockCopy itself still asks generic writingCoach questions on the live settings/profile path and was not switched to coachTool, to keep this slice dark; (3) the page-level composer the row names (one prompt to a valid, reviewable, single-undo page), the bounded critic and the ghosted diff review now have to be squared with ADR-1939 §4 (no drafted copy, no copy diffs): the layout-only ghosted proposals in lib/builder/vera.ts (BLD-402) are the part that survives, and that cut is an owner-session decomposition per ADR-1573; (4) the coerce* readers over tool_use inputs outside lib/ai/, and a count_tokens reading of Vera's prefix with the cache counts on /admin/ai, are unchanged; (5) accept and dismiss telemetry for her questions (EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE §8.1 item 8) is not registered.

2026-11-16 (PROG-E8B, dark, no migration). CLOSED from the REMAINS list above: (5) accept and dismiss telemetry is registered and fired (editor.vera_question_accepted, editor.vera_question_dismissed; ids, block type, position and count only; first-party only, barred from both Google mirrors by a block list with a test), and the Vera-path half of (4): parseBlockCoaching, the two CRM import readers and two importer readers now parse tool_use input through lib/ai/schema.ts. STILL OPEN on this row: (1) the coach is mounted only on the staff canvas's demo Banner, not on the selected block of a real document (left alone: the canvas document is being rewired on PROG-E5); (2) reseedBlockCopy still asks generic writingCoach questions and was not switched to coachTool; (3) the page-level composer, the bounded critic and the ghosted layout review, which need the owner-session cut against ADR-1939 section 4 (ADR-1573); (4, rest) seven readers outside the Vera and builder paths still walk tool_use input by hand (WhatsApp extract, importer extract and vision, listing seeder, launch buildout polish, connections scan, event scan; listed on PROG-E8B); (4b) the count_tokens and cache read/write reading on /admin/ai was NOT built: the split is not stored (ai_settle_attempt folds cache tokens into input_tokens, ai_usage has no cache columns), so it needs a migration (two columns on ai_usage, two more arguments on ai_settle_attempt, the split on ai_budget_status_today) and an owner yes before it can be shown.

2026-11-16 (PROG-E8C, no migration, no UI change). CLOSED from the list above: (4, rest). The seven readers outside the Vera and builder paths (WhatsApp extract, importer extract and vision, listing seeder, launch buildout polish, connections scan, event scan) now read tool_use input through lib/ai/schema.ts, like the five before them. Same output on every valid reply (checked against main on 19,389 fuzzed payloads); on a malformed reply each keeps its safe fallback, and the two that used to throw on a wrong-typed value (listing seeder, importer extract) no longer do. With this, none of the twelve readers PROG-E8B counted outside lib/ai is on a hand-written ladder. NOT re-audited here: the readers inside lib/ai itself (the ADR-1287 increment's own ground; lib/ai/vera-calendar.ts still reads two single fields off a tool input with a cast). STILL OPEN on this row: (1) the coach on real documents: she is mounted only on the staff canvas's demo Banner, not on the selected block of a real document in the Space page builder or the website builder shell (waits on the canvas document rewiring on PROG-E5); (2) reseedBlockCopy still asks generic writingCoach questions and was not switched to coachTool; (3) the page-level composer, the bounded critic and the ghosted layout review, which need the owner-session cut against ADR-1939 section 4 (ADR-1573); (4b) the count_tokens and cache read/write reading on /admin/ai: not built, because the split is not stored, so it needs a migration (two columns on ai_usage, two more arguments on ai_settle_attempt, the split on ai_budget_status_today) and an owner yes first.

UPDATE 2026-11-18 (item 1, partly: the coach on the selected block of a real document, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS): on /pages/canvas with a real Space page document, Vera's coach now sits under the inspector on the selected block, not only on the demo Banner. The client sends the node id; askVeraAboutCanvasBlock reads that node's type from the stored page behind resolveCanvasAccess (an editor of the Space only; a read-only viewer, a malformed id or a node not on the page gets null and nothing is spent) and coaches the fields the block's contract gives the inspector (canvasCoachFor, lib/builder/canvas-inspector.ts). Creation-time only holds: she speaks first only on a block this tab just inserted (useCanvasDocument createdId; a copy is not a creation, and picking another block by hand ends the moment) and only while its word fields are empty; otherwise only on Ask Vera. Tests: app/(main)/pages/canvas/actions-document.test.ts, components/builder/canvas/use-canvas-document-e8.test.tsx. No model call, browser or database run. NOT DONE, and why: (a) the website builder shell: its blocks are the Puck config sections (components/sites/editor, lib/page-editor/config.tsx), which have no E1 block contract, so coachTool has no contract fields to mint from, and that shell is on the launch path with no flag of its own for a model call; mounting her there needs either contracts for the website sections or a rule for coaching Puck fields, plus a rollout switch. (b) The Space page builder shell (components/entity-blocks/space-canvas): same blocks as the canvas, so it is the natural next mount, but it already carries the live reseed writing prompts; one coach, not two, is an owner call. (c) Item 2, reseedBlockCopy to coachTool: blocked by a done row's probe, not by code. LIVE-890's probe (scripts/check-ai-caller-attribution-two.mjs) asserts lib/importer/compose.ts delegates to writingCoach exactly once, and LIVE-1346's probe (scripts/probes/importer-authorship.mjs) loads the action body over it; switching would regress LIVE-890. It needs that probe amended to accept the coachTool seam (an owner or housekeeping decision), then reseedBlockCopy can call an ungated split of coachNewBlock under the same seed-compose budget key.

2026-11-18 (item 4b, the stored split; owner yes 2026-11-18; MIGRATION UNAPPLIED). supabase/migrations/20270346130000_ai_usage_cache_token_split.sql (additive, not applied to any database): two nullable columns on ai_usage, cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens (check >= 0; NULL = not recorded, no backfill because old rows' split is unknowable); input_tokens keeps its meaning (the whole prompt), so every cap and reader is unchanged. A six-argument overload of ai_settle_attempt (p_cache_read_tokens, p_cache_creation_tokens; refuses a split larger than the prompt; replay compares the split) beside the untouched four-argument one, and ai_tokens_today() (per-feature prompt, output, cache read, cache write, split_rows, unsplit_rows), a new function rather than new result columns on ai_budget_status_today, which would need a drop. Both service-role only, anon and authenticated revoked by name. WRITER: lib/ai/accounting.ts settleAiAttempt sends the split from the provider usage fields; while the overload is missing (PGRST202) it settles on the four-argument function and logs ai.accounting.cache_split_unavailable. READER: app/(main)/admin/ai/load-ai.ts reads ai_tokens_today (absence or a bad value gives tokens null and logs ai.accounting.token_split_read_failed, never touching spend) and /admin/ai shows a Prompt cache today column, Not recorded until split rows exist. pgTAP: supabase/tests/ai_usage_cache_token_split.test.sql. One schema-contract ALLOWLIST entry (ai_tokens_today rpc) and a function-grants row. The count_tokens reading of Vera's rendered prefix is still not built. POST-APPLY: apply the migration, regenerate lib/database.types.ts, retire the ALLOWLIST entry and the PGRST202 fallback in settleAiAttempt.

2026-11-23 (PROG-E8D, no migration, no UI change). The count_tokens reading of Vera's prefix now EXISTS as a hand-run command, and the LIVE READING HAS NOT BEEN TAKEN. lib/ai/vera/cached-prefix.ts builds the cached head (tools, then the stable system block with the marker) from the functions the live turn calls, for each of the four tool sets a turn can send; scripts/vera-prefix-tokens.mjs asks the provider's token counting endpoint for its size and prints it beside the tier minimum (lib/ai/models.ts CACHE_MIN_TOKENS). It is in no package.json script and no workflow. The build session had no key and made no network call. Offline description that day: 10,946 bytes for the member tool set (12,731 Space manager, 12,385 operator, 14,170 both), which may well be under the default tier's 4,096-token minimum. OWED: someone with a key runs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... node scripts/vera-prefix-tokens.mjs and appends the numbers and the date here; if the member prefix reads short it is not being cached, and the choice between a longer stable block and a tier with a lower minimum is an owner call. STILL OPEN on this row otherwise, unchanged: the coach on the website builder shell and the Space page builder shell; reseedBlockCopy to coachTool (blocked by LIVE-890's probe); the page-level composer, bounded critic and ghosted layout review (owner-session cut, ADR-1573); applying the cache split migration and its post-apply clean-up.

UPDATE 2026-11-23 (post-apply, item 4b): migration 20270346130000 is APPLIED. It is recorded in schema_migrations in Frequency Community, and ai_tokens_today, the six-argument ai_settle_attempt overload and the two ai_usage cache columns exist (read from the live project on 2026-11-23). This supersedes MIGRATION UNAPPLIED in the 2026-11-18 note. Done in this change, the three post-apply steps that note names: lib/database.types.ts regenerated from the live public schema (both ai_settle_attempt overloads, ai_tokens_today, ai_usage.cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens); the dated ALLOWLIST entry for ai_tokens_today in scripts/check-schema-contract.mjs retired (pnpm check:schema-contract passes without it); and the PGRST202 fallback in settleAiAttempt (lib/ai/accounting.ts) retired, with the ai.accounting.cache_split_unavailable log line. settleAiAttempt now makes one call to the six-argument function; a missing function is a settle failure like any other and takes the conservative hold (lib/ai/accounting.test.ts pins that in place of the fallback case). The reader on /admin/ai is unchanged and still treats any ai_tokens_today error as no split. STILL OPEN on this row: no settled attempt has been read back with its split after the apply, so the Prompt cache today column on /admin/ai is unverified against real rows; the hand-run script for the count_tokens reading of Vera's cached prefix shipped as PROG-E8D (#5442), and the live reading itself has not been taken yet; and items (1) the coach on real documents in the website and Space builder shells, (2) reseedBlockCopy to coachTool, blocked by the LIVE-890 probe, and (3) the page-level composer, bounded critic and ghosted layout review, which need the owner-session cut against ADR-1939 section 4.
